summary.finding: Found by reading production before merge: the browserless row's last_success_at (2026-09-11 06:18Z) had been stamped by the cloud balance read, not by a render. The first version of recordBalanceNotApplicable would have reported the refused container healthy, with a reason claiming a render had succeeded, for up to 24 hours after deploy.
summary.fix: only a last_success_at later than metadata.balance_not_applicable_since (set on the first not-applicable pass; cleared by writeAssessment) counts as endpoint evidence
